systemic_findings.reel_word_count_epidemic: PERSISTENT ISSUE: 7 of 10 scripts have reels exceeding the 200-word limit. This is systemic, not random. The script-generation agent appears to be writing reels as if they were 90-second or 2-minute formats rather than 60-second. Median overcount is ~220-250 words vs. 200-word target. The fix is consistent: the generation agent must be prompted with an explicit 150-word target (not 200) to account for natural verbosity. Recommendation: update video-script-agent system prompt to include word-count enforcement with a working example of a 150-word reel.
systemic_findings.wikipedia_sourcing_systemic: 3 of 10 scripts (electric-axial-flux, pokemon-go, transit-app) use Wikipedia as the primary or only citation source for empirical claims. Wikipedia is appropriate for attributing term origins or well-documented public record, but not for technical spec claims (kW/kg ratings, drone navigation systems) or legal framework claims (third-party doctrine). Script generation agent should be prompted to specify primary source types per topic domain.
